Same rule as honours.json: nothing enters `names` without a fetched source URL, and anything still wanting one waits in `unverified`, which is never applied. A name is the one thing on a place page that has to be right, so a machine transliteration is not an acceptable stand-in here — an absent English name is a smaller error than an invented one.
